spec.training: 75% original clean/coarse augmentation recipe plus 25% targeted replacement
spec.team: Long ball gaps/sampling mask only, native coordinates and players; old Markov augmentation retained
spec.D: Player/coordinate portion of frozen composite corruption; old clean/slot-dropout windows retained
spec.replacement: Quarter of each original team view/direct+swap pairs; quarter of each original D record windows
spec.budget: Unchanged HGB rows/capacity; unchanged GRU window count, batch size, eight epochs and optimizer updates
spec.neural_context: Each input window entirely from one observation variant; no feature splicing inside a window
spec.normalization: Training-only core rows of the selected mixture; same finite-value masks
spec.evaluation: Same clean and two composite-stress views/graded frames as first batch; 90 new plus 30 reused baseline rows
spec.primary: Equal-provider clean spell F1 in D-provider holdouts; exact-tie macro F1; baseline remains eligible
spec.stress: Secondary diagnostic; two seeds averaged within each match; no combined clean/stress selection score
spec.scope: D provider holdouts only; team models pooled; reused development, no fresh confirmation
spec.organizer: No reference labels or new public score; report archived baseline competition metrics separately
